messages:
mia: quick idea — can we route low-tier traffic to cheaper model variants by default and enforce a token-cost cap per request? keeps latency SLAs but cuts unit spend for free/low tiers :money_with_wings:
raj: sounds promising. main risks i see: quality regressions and bursty spikes causing cost to go up if lower-tier hits long contexts
selena: agree on quality risk. also need telemetry to show fallback rate + cost delta by customer tier (per-region too)
tasha: UX question — how will console show this? admins will want per-customer overrides and 'opt-out of cheaper variants' toggle
mia: prototyping an API flag: `allow_variant_fallback` + `max_token_cost_usd` at route/customer level. example config:
```yaml
route: /v1/generate
allow_variant_fallback: true
max_token_cost_usd: 0.0004
preferred_model: gptx-std-16k
fallback_policy:
  - cheaper_variant: gptx-lite-8k
  - max_latency_ms: 300
```
raj: implementation notes — router needs to evaluate (estimated_tokens * cost_per_token(model)) <= max_token_cost_usd before selecting fallback. also need fast cost estimator for streaming requests
selena: for telemetry, add these metrics: `fallback.rate`, `fallback.cost_savings`, `fallback.quality_regressions` (tagged by tier/region/model). wire them to per-route dashboard and anomaly alerts
tasha: console wire: show a small badge on routes using fallback + histogram of savings by week. admin can expand to see per-customer overrides and a button to disable fallback for that customermia: (typo) mea culpa — meant @mia :sweat_smile:
raj: rollout plan: feature flag per region, run canary on 5% of free tier in us-west for 48h, monitor latency, savings, and hallucination rate. if regressions > threshold rollback
selena: telemetry thresholds proposal: savings must be > 10% for canary to continue, and hallucination/incorrect-response metric < 0.5% absolute increase
mia: also need billing integration: show in billing UI the pre/post fallback token cost and cumulative savings per invoice period
tasha: how do we handle multi-model call chains where one step falls back and downstream expects specific tokens? e.g., tools/function calls
raj: conservative approach: disable fallback for routes flagged as "deterministic" or when `response_format` is strict. add `force_model_for_chain: true` opt-in param
selena: one more: quota enforcement — if a customer hits token budget, route them to cheapest available variant instead of 429, unless they opt out. put a hard cap override for security/enterprise customers
mia: action items:
- raj: prototype routing cost check + estimator (PR) — due EOW
- selena: dashboard panels & metrics + alert runbook — due next Wed
- tasha: mock console toggles and admin override UX — due next Mon
- mia: spec for billing integration and rollout plan — will post in docs by EOD
infra-bot: scheduled canary deployment: eng-platform/fallback-routing -> canary(us-west, 5%) at 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z
tasha: thanks all. if no objections i'll mark this as approved and raj can open the feature-flagged PR :thumbsup:
raj: opening PR now -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/route-router/pulls/312 :rocket:
selena: will add dashboard templates to the PR comment
mia: great — let’s keep the canary small and watch the quality metrics closely.
